brief: A change adds a transfer operation to the wallet service.

base.wallet.py:
def transfer(source, target, amount):
    """Move amount by debiting source once and crediting target once."""
    source.debit(amount)
    target.credit(amount)

def transfer(source, target, amount):

    target.credit(amount)
    source.debit(amount)
